about_the_game:
LastTrail is a 2D pixel art platformer that blends time manipulation, atmospheric storytelling, and speedrunning precision into a surreal dreamworld adventure.

You wake up in a world with no sound, no movement—only silence and a voice whispering guidance… or deception. With no memory of how you got here, you must explore this mysterious realm, master time itself, and uncover the truth hidden beneath layers of puzzles, challenges, and powerful bosses.

Whether you're a casual explorer, a platforming perfectionist, or a hardcore speedrunner, LastTrail offers a rich experience with intuitive movement, reactive environments, and secrets tucked into every corner.

Key Features:

  • Time-Slow Mechanic – Control time to solve puzzles, bypass hazards, and outmaneuver enemies.

  • Atmospheric World – A hauntingly beautiful dreamscape brought to life with vibrant pixel art and ambient synth music.

  • Boss Battles & Challenges – Test your skills in intense multi-phase fights and time-based trials.

  • Minimal UI, Maximum Immersion – Let the world, sounds, and visuals guide you.

  • Speedrunning Mode – Compete on global leaderboards and perfect your fastest runs.

  • Narrative Mystery – Discover the truth behind the voice, the world, and yourself.

Explore. Escape. Warp time.
Are you ready to wake up?

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th Gen or newer) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics / Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3) or Intel Core i5 (10th Gen or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2 GPU or AMD Radeon with 2GB VRAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 (2GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
